description: Places a real outbound phone call through Callout's voice agent and returns a call_id at once; the call itself runs in the background and is billed to the signed-in Callout account. Destinations: numbers in Japan, the US and Canada. A call lasts up to 4 minutes (one credit); max_duration_seconds up to 480 allows 8 minutes for complex matters, with the second credit charged only if the call runs past 4 minutes. A call that only asks a question needs no customer details. A call that makes, changes or checks a booking, reservation, appointment or order is refused with CALLBACK_NUMBER_NEEDED, before anything is charged, when its objective and context give no phone number for the customer, because businesses ask for it; skip_callback_number=true is for when the user has chosen to place it without one. A call whose objective or context holds a contact number from a country other than the destination's is refused with FOREIGN_CONTACT_NUMBER unless allow_foreign_contact_number is true, because businesses often can't call or text overseas numbers.
name: callout_create_call
title: Place a phone call
